notes: IWE001 is the only currently extracted strict-H1 mutualist programme; its three site effects are dependent and count as one programme. IWE004 was source-adjudicated from include to context-only.
IWE035 remains the only unresolved-strict antagonist bridge. IWE032-IWE034 are direct nonlinear/bidirectional shape evidence and are not forced into strict linear H1.

IWE064 is the first quantitatively closed strict mixed programme; IWE059 remains unresolved-strict. IWE066 is preregistered-H2 interior-peak shape evidence without a formal numerical curvature coefficient. IWE065 is a benefit-channel-only effect and remains outside net mixed H1.
